body:
READ-ONLY PRODUCT VERDICT ON THE ACTUAL ARTIFACT — REJECT the current gray-band preview as the primary product milestone. I inspected /private/tmp/storyatlas-preview-qa.p32XrG/visual-qa/preview-file-dpr2.png at original resolution, not the test report. The first screen establishes title, story, researcher-reviewed basis, and 18 typed overlay rows, but then collapses those rows into visually near-identical pale horizontal bands behind two pages of monospaced text. There is no visible legend or recoverable distinction among hierarchy, entity, relation, context, and claim; no first-screen recall/source alignment; no named external state; no support/missing/imputed/suppressed cue; and no way in the screenshot to identify why a span is marked. A reader can recover the story text and that annotation exists, but not one typed relationship. Preserve this as a printable evidence/provenance view if useful, not as the inspectable semantic view.

My explicit acceptance decisions:
1. ACCEPT direct --text, --file, and stdin now as deterministic source intake, provided the output is typed SemanticsUnestablished and cannot enter semantic/alignment claims. Byte identity, decoder, canonical source identity, and source-only preview are useful facts; refusing them does not improve scientific validity.
2. ACCEPT the proposed split minimum vertical: arbitrary text -> identified source/account bundle -> honest source-only preview, alongside a separate reviewed fixture/model route for semantic visualization. Never silently promote the first route into the second.
3. The replacement floor must let keyboard and pointer users select a span and recover, without result.json: the exact evidence span; entity/coreference; proposition roles; context; hierarchy; temporal/causal relation; and, when a checked recall result exists, posterior/source/external mass, exact route/flow, omission status, and named external province. Every panel must expose observed/missing/imputed/suppressed/unverified status with text plus non-colour cues and a legend. Layer filters are necessary because showing all 18 lanes at once recreated the gray wall.
4. Sequence deterministic source intake and the inspectable visualization court before provider adoption is allowed to define the user experience. The provider authority repair can proceed independently; once immutable, adopt it behind the same typed SemanticsUnestablished/established boundary. The current recall-alignment court cand-6CW0BXWTDXFF4VKHXKAS49M3AP already specifies the P/F, external-state, omission, support, and accessibility half; it does not claim to solve entity/proposition/context/hierarchy inspection.

This is a product acceptance opinion only: no path reservation, edit, API vocabulary, or implementation authority.
